entries.name: Jito ShredStream
entries.finding: Jito docs announce the ShredStream shutdown from 2026-09-05. This is separate from Jito Block Engine transaction delivery.
entries.use: Do not build a new dependency on the retired feed. Preserve Jito Block Engine as a separate delivery component under PR130.
entries.blocker: No feed availability after sunset; replacement source must be separately qualified.

entries.name: LocalShred Lite / DedicatedNodes
entries.finding: DedicatedNodes advertises a free Lite tier as a baseline similar to former Jito ShredStream. Paid/hosted LocalShred product claims must not be applied to Lite.
entries.use: First candidate for bounded read-only A/B under an authorized source profile.
entries.blocker: Need current access terms, endpoint contract, regional path, packet completeness/loss/replay and independent latency benchmark. No 100-500ms lead claim accepted.

entries.name: DoubleZero Edge
entries.finding: Raw UDP multicast feed; current metro seat pricing is monthly and varies by region, approximately $450-$1,500/month. Older $30-$100 per epoch claim is not current evidence. No free-trial entitlement is assumed.
entries.use: Optional paid feed comparator only after operator approval and written quote.
entries.blocker: Requires region/network/GRE/decapsulation engineering; feed does not provide retransmission; packet loss and completeness need measurement.

entries.name: OrbitFlare ShredStream
entries.finding: Provider lists raw UDP shredstream with regional $500/$1,000 monthly tiers. No universal 60-minute trial was verified; NFT pass offer is restricted by provider conditions.
entries.use: Optional paid regional comparator.
entries.blocker: Need written trial/SLA/terms, IP allowlist, public IP, bandwidth and own deshredding. Vendor latency/first-arrival metrics are claims to reproduce.

entries.name: Triton Yellowstone / Shredstream
entries.finding: Yellowstone/Geyser gRPC and raw shred streaming are distinct products; raw shreds are priced separately (page lists from $450/month or $0.18 per 15-minute period).
entries.use: Use existing Yellowstone interface if approved; raw shreds only after separate paid-feed approval.
entries.blocker: No general free raw-shred tier established.

entries.name: Helius LaserStream / Shreds
entries.finding: Free RPC plan does not mean free raw shreds. Shreds are separately priced; LaserStream and preprocessed transaction feeds have product/plan-specific schemas and limitations.
entries.use: Current authorized LaserStream or RPC observation may be compared; raw shreds require separate plan.
entries.blocker: Verify plan tier, data schema, credit model, replay, completeness and costs. Do not call preprocessed stream equivalent to raw shreds.

entries.name: GetBlock Solana Shred Streams
entries.finding: Current page advertises raw shred streams as a paid product; GetBlock pages give conflicting trial details.
entries.use: Candidate only after direct written confirmation.
entries.blocker: Do not encode a free 2-hour/24-hour trial or price assumptions without current provider quote.

entries.name: ValidatorsDAO solana-stream
entries.finding: Public SDK/workspace supports Shreds and Geyser/gRPC clients. UDP path may be incomplete, out-of-order or pre-finalization; experimental filtering/continuity must be tested. Workspace current versions differ from pasted v4 reference.
entries.use: Possible self-hosted decoder/client in a pinned isolated test harness.
entries.blocker: Pin immutable commit and test wire compatibility, fork/replay/completeness; SDK use does not grant paid feed access.

entries.name: ERPC Solana Stream SDK
entries.finding: Release notice reports internal Rust processing benchmark gains for v4; this is not end-to-end network lead. ValidatorsDAO workspace has advanced beyond v4.
entries.use: Benchmark/release reference only; compare current SDK version to repo baseline.
entries.blocker: Need exact crate/repo commit, hardware, methodology, packet completeness and end-to-end p50/p99 tests.

entries.name: Supanode
entries.finding: The pasted file claims RPC/WebSocket/gRPC/ShredStream and a trial, but no canonical product contract was verified in this sweep.
entries.use: Keep as a research lead only.
entries.blocker: Require official docs, company/product identity, trial terms, pricing, schemas, security and SLA.

entries.name: Self-hosted ShredStream / validator proximity
entries.finding: A self-operated validator/peering architecture is a separate infrastructure and operational project, not a free source.
entries.use: Long-term infrastructure research only.
entries.blocker: No deployment or validator operation in this pack.

entries.name: solana-arb-executor
entries.finding: README describes a Claude Code/Codex skill scaffold for a Rust execution hot path; it is not a running executor crate/service. MIT is stated in its repository.
entries.use: Review safety/risk-gate/template concepts selectively; do not add as runtime dependency.
entries.blocker: Codegen output requires independent review and compatibility; no execution authority.

entries.name: solana-arb-framework (ototech7)
entries.finding: README describes educational Rust/Anchor arbitrage across legacy venues; not production and not verified Prop AMM coverage.
entries.use: Historical educational reference only.
entries.blocker: No production integration.

entries.name: solana-arb-framework (sripathiabhiram29-droid)
entries.finding: README describes Python live loop, wallet/keypair credentials, mainnet settings and dashboard toggles. No assurance/production evidence established.
entries.use: Do not import or execute.
entries.blocker: Credential/live-loop risk; license and security posture not validated.

entries.name: Capture OS / Capture Engine
entries.finding: No canonical source repository or API was identified by this name.
entries.use: Use the repository's existing source capture / governance owners; do not create a parallel Capture OS.
entries.blocker: Need exact canonical URL and license/API before reconsideration.

entries.name: KADES
entries.finding: Landing page describes Kinetic Anomaly Detection Engine System and early access; no public repo/API schema or independent benchmark validated.
entries.use: Optional external anomaly hint only after API/schema/terms and precision-recall evidence.
entries.blocker: No dependency, authority, signal truth or trade trigger allowed.

entries.name: CADES
entries.finding: No canonical crypto/Solana project matching the pasted description was verified.
entries.use: Do not add until exact URL and product identity supplied.
entries.blocker: Source not identified.

entries.name: sol-parser-sdk (0xfnzero)
entries.finding: Cargo metadata shows v0.11.0, Rust 2021, rust-version 1.91, MIT, pinned Solana SDK/Yellowstone versions; parser coverage must be checked per program. Local microbenchmark figures are not end-to-end guarantees.
entries.use: Optional isolated parser adapter after version compatibility and differential tests.
entries.blocker: Solana SDK/Yellowstone version compatibility and Prop AMM parser coverage; no assumed 10-20us service guarantee.

entries.name: LimeChain pmm-sim
entries.finding: v0.2.0, Rust Edition 2024, LiteSVM 0.10 and Solana SDK 3.0 dependencies; README documents single/multi/direct/benchmark and named Prop AMM versions. Cargo.toml references mutable Magnus branch.
entries.use: Isolated pinned offline simulation/differential harness.
entries.blocker: Pin commit and transitive git deps; SDK isolation. Simulation cannot prove live solver quote, execution or fill.

entries.name: LiteSVM
entries.finding: In-process SVM environment for program testing.
entries.use: Deterministic local instruction/program tests.
entries.blocker: Not a market data feed or production route/transaction sender.

entries.name: Mollusk SVM
entries.finding: Focused SVM program/instruction testing and CU measurement.
entries.use: Instruction fixtures, error and compute tests.
entries.blocker: Not a live quote engine or production executor.

entries.name: Pinocchio
entries.finding: Anza zero-dependency/no_std/zero-copy Rust library for writing Solana programs; optimized for CU and binary size. Not an off-chain router and no fixed 84% saving is established.
entries.use: Only for separately justified on-chain program implementation after profile shows a CU/size bottleneck.
entries.blocker: Separate security/program review; not needed for off-chain flashloan bot by default.

entries.name: Jupiter Swap API V2 /order
entries.finding: Current V2 order endpoint is the routing/quote/order surface; legacy Quote API shorthand should not be treated as current integration contract.
entries.use: Amount-specific route comparator via existing R13 quote normalization.
entries.blocker: Pin version, API key/rate terms, route lineage, context and schema.

entries.name: Jupiter Swap API V2 /build
entries.finding: Returns raw instruction components for caller-owned transaction composition; caller is responsible for transaction assembly, validation, simulation, signing and submission.
entries.use: Build custom unsigned instruction plan only.
entries.blocker: Validate every instruction, ALT, token program, min-out, CU, account size and same-tx repay; no submit.

entries.name: 1000xsh/swaps
entries.finding: v0.1.1 Rust 2024 library fetches account plans, decodes snapshots and builds allocation-free swap instruction views. It does not quote or infer slippage. Upstream notes say HumidiFi ignores min_amount_out; Tessera direct top-level path has caveats; SolFi is slot/oracle-sensitive.
entries.use: Potential per-venue direct builder, after immutable pin and exact account/program conformance.
entries.blocker: No quote engine. Venue-specific minout/guard and SDK/API compatibility must be proven.

entries.name: Astralane Iris
entries.finding: Provider advertises optimized regional routing and dynamic tip ceiling/clearing/rebate mechanics; public iris-rs repo is beta and AGPL-3.0. Do not infer current minimum tip or actual clearing costs from old pasted values.
entries.use: Separate later sender-qualification candidate.
entries.blocker: Need exact vendor endpoint docs, plan, pricing, rebate/billing rules, test data, legal/license review.

entries.name: Helius Sender SWQoS-only
entries.finding: SWQoS-only min tip listed as 0.000005 SOL, best-effort and outside priority tip buffer; Sender Max begins at 0.001 SOL with separate pathway/performance.
entries.use: Separate future provider candidate with capability tier modeled explicitly.
entries.blocker: No automatic equivalence between min tip and competitive inclusion; price/latency/failure experiments required.

entries.name: Syncro Sender / P2P.org
entries.finding: Current product page lists public/secured per-landed transaction rates and new-client trial; older help page lists different rates. Require written current contract.
entries.use: Candidate only for separate provider contract comparison.
entries.blocker: Resolve current rate card, regions, eligibility, tip/refund terms and duplicate billing.

entries.name: Sanctum Gateway
entries.finding: The pasted file gives a per-transaction price, but current API/billing semantics were not verified.
entries.use: Do not implement now.
entries.blocker: Need canonical docs, endpoint schema and current fee contract.

entries.name: BoltTx
entries.finding: Pasted tier/points and landed-fee claims were not verified against a current authoritative source.
entries.use: Do not implement now.
entries.blocker: Need provider-owned current pricing and API docs.

entries.name: Nozomi
entries.finding: Pasted claim about pay-on-success and minimum tip not independently verified in this source sweep.
entries.use: Do not implement now.
entries.blocker: Need provider-owned current pricing, endpoint docs and billing proof.

entries.name: Jito Block Engine transaction send/bundles
entries.finding: Jito documents sendTransaction and bundles separately; bundles support up to five signed transactions atomically. Current repo PR130 policy narrows first-production use to a single strategy transaction.
entries.use: Preserve current PR130 JITO_SINGLE policy.
entries.blocker: No live sender activation; ACK/bundle ID not settlement; bundle semantics cannot silently override repo policy.

entries.name: Jito ShredStream proxy client
entries.finding: The proxy client repository is distinct from the feed service. Jito's feed service was sunset 2026-09-05; an accessible client repo does not imply an active feed or a current compatible endpoint.
entries.use: Source-reading / protocol history only; do not add as an active feed dependency.
entries.blocker: Feed sunset; verify current upstream state, license and compatibility before any fork/maintenance.

entries.name: Jupiter Quote API (legacy wording)
entries.finding: The pasted text uses generic Quote API language. New integration must pin the current Swap API V2 /order contract; do not mix legacy endpoint semantics with V2 /build.
entries.use: Compatibility mapping only for any existing legacy Jupiter quote owner.
entries.blocker: Confirm current project adapter and avoid a parallel quote client.

entries.name: UnifiedRelayerAdapter
entries.finding: No canonical upstream repository or existing adapter implementation was identified; treat this as a design label, not a package or ready-made SDK.
entries.use: Only a future capability interface owned by the repository's existing submission subsystem, after design review.
entries.blocker: Must not create a parallel sender service or enable multi-relay fan-out.

policy.evidence_rule: Unknown is not zero; vendor claims are not benchmark evidence; fixture/replay is not live.
